title: Selected calls in a fictional trace
method: Invented bounded capture with 100 selected calls: 40 opens + 10 connects + 50 reads. Counts exclude unselected calls and CPU-only work. Error semantics and latency cannot be inferred from counts alone.
alt: Selected calls in a fictional trace. Configuration opens: 40 calls; Connection attempts: 10 calls; Reads: 50 calls. Illustrative inputs.
